steps.instruction: Confirm the imprimatura is dry to touch with no lift when you drag a knuckle across it.
Mix one dark — raw umber, or umber knocked back with a touch of black — thinned lean. No white yet if you want a wipe-out underpainting; add white only for a built-up grisaille.
State the shadow shapes first: mass in everything darker than mid-value as one connected pattern. Squint — if a shape disappears when you squint, it does not belong in this layer.
Pull lights out with a rag or dry brush rather than painting them in. The ground tone is your light for now.
Stop while it reads as three values: ground, half-tone, dark. Detail added now is detail you will bury later.
